title: cvpw qa/gold.json
description: The determinism witness: frame content hashes for a fixed set of times. Regenerated only with --update-gold and a stated reason, because a gold file that drifts silently makes the whole determinism guarantee decorative.

fixture.description: What was hashed: a project path or a template id. A gold file with no fixture is unverifiable.

renderer.description: The renderer string at the time the gold was taken. A different GPU is a legitimate reason for a mismatch, and stating it turns a mystery into a decision.

dpr.description: Supersampling factor. Part of the identity of a render, so a gold taken at dpr 2 does not describe a dpr 1 render.

grain.description: Whether the grain pass was active. Seam and hash comparison must run with grain off.

tolerance.description: Fraction of sampled cells allowed to differ, for GPU float noise. 0 means exact. Raising it is a decision to be recorded in docs/PROGRESS.md, not a convenience.

frames.description: Frame index (as a string key) to content hash. Keys are frame indices rather than seconds so that a time-base change cannot silently shift which frames are compared.

reason.description: Why this gold was (re)taken. Required in practice: an unexplained baseline is indistinguishable from an accident.
